steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist
from collections import Counter

playlist_genres = {}
for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # most_common returns list of (genre, count) sorted by count desc, then insertion order for ties
    most_common = counter.most_common(1)[0][0]
    playlist_genres[pl['playlist_id']] = most_common
    print(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], '->', most_common, counter)
